content.rendered: Our Annual Archer Glen “Share The Love” food drive will begin on Monday, Feb. 3rd and run until Thursday, Feb. 13th. Our Food Drive supports Willowbrook Food Pantry in Sherwood and Sherwood residents in need. This year we will be having a POD Competition. So, points will be combined from the four classrooms in each pod and all pods will be competing against each other. This is a fun way to support a great cause! Check your child’s backpack for a flyer with more information.
